# <span id="aanchor51"></span> Email a Report

<div class="procedure">

To email a report:

1.  Select one or more reports and the data to display.

2.  Click the **Email** button.

3.  Click the **To:** button to select a recipient.

    If you are emailing multiple reports, a separate email will be generated for each report.

4.  Select the file format to export the report to, such as PDF. (See: [Crystal Export Types](Crystal%20Export%20Types.md))

5.  Enter a subject and a message.

6.  Check the **Compress Report Files** option to compress the files into a .zip file before emailing them.

7.  Click **OK**.
